skills.description: M. Scott Peck's The Road Less Traveled — an executable toolkit for personal growth through discipline, love, spiritual growth, and embracing life's difficulties.  Covers 5 use cases: ① Discipline — embrace challenges and delay gratification ("Life is hard — how do I handle it?" "How do I stop seeking instant pleasure") ② Responsibility — own your problems ("Why do I blame others for my problems?" "How do I take ownership of my life") ③ Love — understand love as deliberate action, not feeling ("What is real love?" "Is this love or dependency?") ④ Spiritual Growth — find meaning through suffering ("How do I grow through pain?" "How do I find purpose?") ⑤ Grace — understand why some grow and others stay stuck ("Why do some people change and others don't?")  Trigger when users say: "Life is so hard" "How do I become more disciplined" "How do I delay gratification" "What is real love" "How do I grow through suffering" "How do I take responsibility for my life" "I feel stuck in my personal growth" "How do I find meaning in pain" or mention: Scott Peck / road less traveled / discipline / love / grace / spiritual growth / delayed gratification / personal responsibility / the problem of evil / genuine love. Also triggers on install.

skills.description: Peter Drucker's The Essential Drucker — an executable toolkit that applies Drucker's six decades of management wisdom: the five deadly business sins, management by objectives, innovation, the knowledge worker, the effective executive, and leading change.  Covers 5 use cases: ① Management Fundamentals — core principles of effective management ("How to be a better manager" "What does management actually mean") ② The Five Deadly Business Sins — avoid the mistakes that destroy companies ("What are the biggest business mistakes" "Why do successful companies fail") ③ Innovation & Entrepreneurship — how to innovate systematically ("How to innovate in business" "What makes an entrepreneurial company") ④ The Effective Executive — personal effectiveness for knowledge workers ("How to be an effective executive" "What makes a great leader") ⑤ Leading Change — manage organizations through transformation ("How to lead organizational change" "How to make decisions in turbulent times")  Trigger when users say: "Peter Drucker" "The Essential Drucker" "Management" "Business management" "How to be a good manager" "Innovation" "Effective executive" "Knowledge worker" "Business strategy" "Leadership" "Management by objectives" or mention: Peter Drucker / The Essential Drucker / management / business / innovation / entrepreneurship / knowledge worker / effective executive / management by objectives / MBO / leadership / organization / change management / strategy / decision making / social responsibility.  Related skills: the-servant (leadership), 7-habits (personal effectiveness), leadership-in-turbulent-times (crisis leadership).
